items: Where did the tasks come from?
sales-mama.ai's labelled data and the care datasets, made fictional: 143 tasks.
One sandbox per task; mama-tool is the only way to act; gold stays outside.
The end state: answer, action log, file diff. A rule break makes it 0.
Three trials, bootstrap CIs, shared ranks when they overlap.
results → build_static.py → data.json → a static Space. The first run caught a leak.
Sanity-check, run your adapter with --trials 3, open a pull request.
